build_fastapi_app: build a FastAPI app with CORS middleware and static file serving for a web UI backend
run_api_server: run the FastAPI server that serves static files and includes fileviewer and static routers
configure_cors_middleware: configure CORS middleware to allow requests from localhost:3000 with all methods and headers
mount_static_files: mount a StaticFiles directory at the /static path for serving frontend assets
include_routers: include the static and fileviewer API routers into the main FastAPI application
